draft.author: Lance Zierlein
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.98, the 141st-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 10th of 21 at S. He went 152nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (85th percentile), vertical jump (94th percentile). College production: 52 tackles in 2020, 8th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.
